title: Design System: Lorenz Tazan Infrastructure Operations Manual

data.purpose: Indexes, controls, provenance, labels, and document metadata.

components.name: Primary Manual Button
components.description: Primary résumé, work-register, and form action.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:1.2rem; min-height:44px; padding:.7rem .9rem; border:1px solid var(--ink); border-radius:2px; color:var(--paper); background:var(--ink); font:700 .7rem/1.5 var(--font-data); letter-spacing:.035em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background:var(--oxide-deep); border-color:var(--oxide-deep); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Secondary Manual Button
components.description: Secondary action with ink reversal on hover.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:1.2rem; min-height:44px; padding:.7rem .9rem; border:1px solid var(--ink); border-radius:2px; color:var(--ink); background:transparent; font:700 .7rem/1.5 var(--font-data); letter-spacing:.035em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { color:var(--paper); background:var(--ink); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Manual Form Field
components.description: Labelled contact input using the raised paper surface.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:.4rem; color:var(--ink); font:700 .63rem/1.5 var(--font-data); text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-field input { width:100%; padding:.72rem .75rem; border:1px solid var(--ink); border-radius:2px; color:var(--ink); background:var(--paper-raised); caret-color:var(--oxide); font:400 1rem/1.5 var(--font-body); } .ds-field input::placeholder { color:var(--ink-soft); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Selected Role Lens
components.html: SYSTEMS & NETWORK→
components.css: .ds-role-lens { display:grid; grid-template-columns:38px 1fr auto; gap:.7rem; align-items:center; min-height:78px; padding:.75rem; border:1px solid var(--ink); border-radius:3px; color:var(--paper); background:var(--ink); text-decoration:none; } .ds-role-lens svg { width:38px; height:38px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.5; } .ds-role-lens strong { font:700 1.15rem/1 var(--font-display); text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-role-lens:hover { color:var(--paper); } .ds-role-lens:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Operation Record
components.description: Evidence-specific record, not a generic content card.
components.html:
02

REGIONAL ISP CORE OPERATIONS

Portfolio-safe telecommunications evidence.

SANITIZED ARCHITECTURE
A. SITUATION

A service environment required stable routing and maintainable controls.
components.css: .ds-operation-record { overflow:hidden; border:1px solid var(--ink); border-radius:3px; color:var(--ink); background:var(--paper-raised); box-shadow:0 8px 24px -22px var(--shadow); } .ds-operation-record header { display:grid; grid-template-columns:48px 1fr; border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule); } .ds-operation-record header>b { display:grid; place-items:center; border-right:1px solid var(--rule); font:700 2.35rem/1 var(--font-display); } .ds-operation-record header>div, .ds-operation-record section { padding:.65rem .75rem; } .ds-operation-record h3 { margin:0; font:700 1.25rem/1 var(--font-display); } .ds-operation-record p { margin:.25rem 0 0; font:400 .76rem/1.38 var(--font-body); } .ds-operation-record>small { display:block; padding:.33rem .7rem; border-bottom:1px dashed var(--rule); color:var(--blueprint); font:700 .52rem/1.5 var(--font-data); } .ds-operation-record em { color:var(--oxide); font:700 .54rem/1.5 var(--font-data); font-style:normal; }

narrative.overview: The portfolio behaves like a field document prepared for review: dense but ordered, technical without becoming ornamental, and explicit about which evidence is professional, sanitized, or laboratory work. Its visual confidence comes from scale, one-pixel construction rules, original infrastructure geometry, and restrained inspection color—not from product-dashboard conventions. The system has two equal operating scenes. Drafting-paper mode uses warm vellum under navy-black ink; night operations uses navy-black film under pale instrument text. Both preserve identical hierarchy and evidence semantics.
keyCharacteristics: Compressed display lettering with hyperlegible body copy and measured mono data.
One-pixel rules, square plates, small radii, and technical grid alignment.
Oxide red is an inspection accent; blueprint blue marks diagrams and provenance.
Every project reads as Situation → Intervention → Verified Result.
Illustrative infrastructure geometry is clearly separated from factual outcome claims.

rules.name: The Inspection Accent Rule
rules.body: Oxide identifies state, sequence, or approval; it never becomes a large decorative field.

rules.name: The Paired Theme Rule
rules.body: Dark mode swaps paper and ink roles while preserving oxide and blueprint semantics; it is not a separate visual brand.

rules.name: The Three-Instrument Rule
rules.body: Barlow names the subject, Atkinson explains it, and JetBrains measures it; do not exchange their roles for variety.

rules.name: The Drafting-Sheet Rule
rules.body: Prefer a rule or a tonal shift before adding a shadow; depth supports evidence grouping, never spectacle.

dos: Do preserve the identity → role lens → evidence → résumé/contact reading order.
Do label every project with one approved provenance category.
Do use original SVG geometry for technical systems and a clear illustrative disclaimer.
Do keep all primary content in prerendered HTML and preserve keyboard, no-JavaScript, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do use mono only for document controls, indexes, measurements, provenance, and operational metadata.
donts: Don't publish unverified metrics, credentials, employers, responsibilities, or production outcomes.
Don't restore location, immigration, or other private job-search context.
Don't add generic dashboard cards, rounded pills, glass panels, gradient text, or decorative data widgets.
Don't use field labels as generic marketing kickers on ordinary route headings.
Don't introduce photography or remote decorative assets unless their provenance and relevance are confirmed.
